exposure: antibiotic prophylaxis administration (type, timing, dosage, duration, route)
outcome: suitability of antibiotic prophylaxis based on local and international guidelines
cohort: The study observed patients who underwent surgical procedures during hospitalization at a private hospital in Indonesia within the period of January-June 2019.
finding: The study found considerable non-compliance with local and international guidelines regarding antibiotic prophylaxis administration in the hospital setting, with Ceftriaxone being the first-choice prophylactic antibiotic.
